description: Start streaming workspace data to the user's own bucket, ready to load into Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Athena or DuckDB. Sequenzy first writes a small test file to confirm access; the call fails with a readable reason when the bucket, region or key is wrong. The first export starts immediately. Use provider "gcs" with an HMAC key for Google Cloud Storage. Ask the user for the credentials; never invent them.

accessKeyId.description: Access key ID (GCS: HMAC access ID).

bucket.description: Bucket name only, not a URL.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

datasets.description: What to export. email_events: sends, deliveries, bounces, complaints, opens, clicks, unsubscribes. sms_events: SMS lifecycle. custom_events: events tracked via API/SDK/integrations. subscribers: a daily snapshot of every subscriber. Default: email_events, custom_events, subscribers.

endpoint.description: Optional HTTPS origin of an S3-compatible service (Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze). Leave empty for AWS and GCS.

frequency.description: How often new data is written. Default: every_15_minutes.

pathPrefix.description: Folder inside the bucket. Files land under <pathPrefix>/<dataset>/date=YYYY-MM-DD/.

provider.description: s3 for Amazon S3 or any S3-compatible service (with `endpoint`); gcs for Google Cloud Storage.

region.description: Bucket region in lowercase, for example us-east-1. Required for Amazon S3; optional for GCS, where it defaults to auto.

secretAccessKey.description: Secret access key (GCS: HMAC secret). Stored encrypted and never returned.

startFrom.description: Optional ISO timestamp up to 30 days ago to include events recorded since then. Default: now.

name: create_data_export

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_data_export` MCP tool.

dataExport.description: The data export record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
